text:
Both the amplitude and the frequency of a sound wave decrease.
What happens to the sound that is heard?
A
The sound is louder and has a higher pitch.
B
The sound is louder and has a lower pitch.
C
The sound is quieter and has a higher pitch.
D
The sound is quieter and has a lower pitch.

options.label: A
options.text: The sound is louder and has a higher pitch.

options.label: B
options.text: The sound is louder and has a lower pitch.

options.label: C
options.text: The sound is quieter and has a higher pitch.

options.label: D
options.text: The sound is quieter and has a lower pitch.
